<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

The configuration of Hy3-FP8 uses `lm_head==fp32`, which results in the use of a standard `torch.matmul(hidden_states.float(), weight.Float().T)` operation on the CPU. However, the `weight` matrix has already been packed, leading to incorrect logits and subsequent errors during sampling.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->
* enable Hy3-fp8 model on Xeon
  * skip AMX weight packing when `lm_head==fp32`
  * add `fused_experts_fp8_pertensor_kernel` for Hy3-fp8 model on Xeon (Hy3-fp8 uses per_tensor)

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

The accuracy result of Hy3-FP8 is: 0.98

```bash
# server
sglang serve \
  --model tencent/Hy3-FP8 \
  --device cpu \
  --tp 6

# client
python -m sglang.test.run_eval \
  --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --port 30000 \
  --eval-name gsm8k \
  --num-examples 200 \
  --num-shots 1 \
  --num-threads 1
```
